verses.1: And on that day of the Pentecost, everyone was in the same state.
verses.2: And suddenly, a sound came from the sky, like the rush of rushing air. It filled the entire room where they were sitting.
verses.3: And languages that could be divided among them appeared to them like fire. Each of these languages was assigned to one of them.
verses.4: And all the holy spirits were stirred up, and they began to speak in other languages, as the spirit commanded them to do.
verses.5: And those who lived in Jerusalem were Jews, men of good character from all nations under heaven.
verses.6: Due to the way this voice was pronounced, the crowd became more and more dispersed. It became so that each person spoke in their own distinct dialect.
verses.7: They also wondered and marveled, saying, “Are all these people who are speaking Galilaeans indeed?”
verses.8: And how do we hear, in our own language, each one of us being born from this?
verses.9: Also, the people of Medo, Elam, and those who live along the Middle Euphrates River, including Jews and Cappadocians, as well as the people of Pontus and Asia.
verses.10: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the regions of Libya along the Cyrenaic coast, as well as the Romans who settled there.
verses.11: The Jews and their converts, the Cretans and the Arabs, we hear them speaking of the great things of God in their own languages.
verses.12: But they all wondered and discussed it among themselves, saying to each other: “What is this supposed to be?”
verses.13: But others, being annoyed, said that Glaukos had been deceived.
verses.14: But Peter stood still, along with the twelve men, and he proclaimed his message to them. The Jewish men and all those who lived in Jerusalem, let this be known to you: understand and unite my words.
verses.15: For they will not be able to do so, as you understand. It’s actually the third day of the week.
verses.16: But this is what was said by the prophet Joel.
verses.17: And in the last days, says God, I will take away every trace of my spirit from all flesh. Then your sons and daughters will see visions, and your young men will dream dreams. And your old men will dream dreams in their sleep.
verses.18: And indeed, on those days, I will take away their spirits from them, and they will prophesy.
verses.19: And I will give wonders in the heavens above, and signs on the earth below. Blood, fire, and smoke, and vapor.
verses.20: The sun will turn into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great day of the Lord comes and shines brightly.
verses.21: And there will be those who, when they are called by the name of the Lord, will be saved.
verses.22: Men of Israel, have you heard these words. Jesus Nazarene, a man who was approved by God to come among you in power and miracles, and through signs that God did through him among you, as you yourselves know.
verses.23: By the predetermined plan and foresight of God, they were taken away by those who were against Him.
verses.24: That man was raised up by the God, after he had broken free from the bonds of death. For it was not possible for him to remain under His control.
verses.25: For David said to him, “I have set my Lord before me in all things; it is from my right side that I must not fall.”
verses.26: Therefore, my heart became cheerful, and my tongue became kind. Even my flesh will hope in hope.
verses.27: Because you will not leave my soul in darkness, nor will you allow your beauty to be seen in shame.
verses.28: If you recognize me as a companion in life, then pay me generously, with your own face.
verses.29: Men, brothers, I must speak to you with respect regarding the patriarch David. He also died and was buried. His tomb is among us, right up to this day.
verses.30: Therefore, since there was a prophet, and knowing that God commanded him to sit on his throne from the fruit of his own tree,
verses.31: He spoke about the resurrection, saying that neither he nor his body were destroyed or damaged in any way.
verses.32: At that moment, God raised Jesus up. We are all witnesses to this.
verses.33: On the right side of the God, he stood there, receiving the message from the Holy Spirit from his Father. This is what you see and hear.
verses.34: For David did not go up into the heavens, he said. The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit by my right side.”
verses.35: Until I have defeated your enemies under the cover of your feet.
verses.36: Therefore, let every family in Israel know that God also created him as a Lord and Savior. This is Jesus, whom you crucified.
verses.37: When they heard this, their hearts sank. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “What should we do, brothers?”
verses.38: But Peter said to them, “Repent, and then let each of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, so that you may be forgiven your sins. And let you receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.”
verses.39: For it is our message, both to your sons and to all those who are invited by our Lord for a long time to come.
verses.40: He was convinced by two different arguments, and he called upon them, saying, “Save yourselves from this cruel fate.”
verses.41: Those who accepted his words were baptized. On that day, they stood before him like three thousand people.
verses.42: They were also hesitant about the teachings of the apostles, as well as about the sharing of food and prayer.
verses.43: And fear was present in the hearts of everyone; many strange things and signs also occurred due to the apostles.
verses.44: But all those who believed were also on the same path, and they had everything in common.
verses.45: And they also distributed the resources and possessions among everyone, according to their needs.
verses.46: Every day, they would gather together in the temple, baking bread at home. They enjoyed their food with joy and gratitude in their hearts.
verses.47: They praised the God, and they had a gift for all the people. The Lord, however, would meet with those who were beaten every day at that place.
